title: Operational Logistics Fast-Track Certificate
description:
An intensive 4-module boot camp designed for immediate operational readiness in international freight forwarding. Master end-to-end shipment lifecycles, critical shipping documentation (MBL/HBL, Air Waybills), Incoterms 2020 risk mapping, customs clearance via ICEGATE, and freight costing with real-world case studies and practical auditing templates.

“Master International Freight Operations in Just 6 Hours!” – Tirwin Talent
date: Batch A: Nov 18 & 19 | Batch B: Nov 25 & 26 (4:00 PM – 7:00 PM IST)
objective: To equip non-operations executives, entry-level supply chain professionals, and job seekers with immediate operational readiness, end-to-end execution workflows, and compliance clarity in international freight forwarding.
targetAudience: Fresh graduates (BBA, B.Com, MBA, Logistics) looking to break into international trade
Entry-level logistics staff and customs documentation executives seeking fast-track career growth
Freight forwarding and customer support executives wanting end-to-end operational clarity
Working professionals in procurement, export-import (EXIM), and trading firms

outcomes: Understand the global freight ecosystem: Shippers, Liners, NVOCCs, 3PLs/4PLs, container dynamics (FCL/LCL), and air cargo urgency vs. cost trade-offs
Master the end-to-end shipment lifecycle: Export/import workflows, booking placements, milestone tracking, arrival notices, DO releases, and CFS/ICD operations
Confidently prepare and audit core documentation: Master/House Bills of Lading (MBL/HBL), Air Waybills (MAWB/HAWB), Telex releases, and Incoterms 2020 cost/risk transfers

blocks.title: Module 1: Global Freight Ecosystem & Multimodal Modes
blocks.subtitle: Roles of Shippers, Liners, NVOCCs, 3PLs/4PLs; FCL vs. LCL container dynamics; Air cargo urgency vs. cost trade-offs
modules: Roles & interplay: Shippers, Ocean Liners, NVOCCs, and 3PL/4PL logistics service providers
Ocean freight container dynamics: FCL (Full Container Load) vs. LCL (Less than Container Load)
Air cargo fundamentals: Urgency vs. cost trade-offs, density factors, and routing choices
Selecting optimal multimodal transportation combinations for global trade lanes

blocks.title: Module 2: End-to-End Shipment Lifecycle & Workflows
blocks.subtitle: Export/import execution workflows, booking placements, milestone tracking, arrival notices, Delivery Order releases, and CFS/ICD operations
modules: Standard operating workflows for export and import shipment execution
Carrier booking placements, equipment release orders, and container stuffing protocols
Milestone tracking, exception management, and proactive arrival notices to consignees
Delivery Order (DO) issuance, CFS (Container Freight Station) & ICD (Inland Container Depot) handoffs

blocks.title: Module 3: Core Shipping Documentation & Incoterms 2020
blocks.subtitle: Master/House Bills of Lading (MBL/HBL), Air Waybills (MAWB/HAWB), Telex releases, Incoterms 2020 cost/risk transfer mapping
modules: Master Bills of Lading (MBL) vs. House Bills of Lading (HBL) roles and liability distribution
Air Waybills (MAWB/HAWB) structure, cargo consignments, and airway documentation standards
Surrender procedures, Sea Waybills, and Telex release authorizations
Incoterms 2020 rules: Pinpoint cost, risk, and insurance transfer points between buyer and seller

blocks.title: Module 4: Customs Clearance, Compliance & Freight Costing
blocks.subtitle: HS Code classification, ICEGATE filing, customs duties/inspections, volumetric vs. chargeable weight calculations, and basic freight quotes
modules: Harmonized System (HS) Code classification principles and tariff schedules
Indian customs clearance process & electronic documentation filing via ICEGATE
Customs duty calculations, physical inspections, and compliance risk avoidance strategies
Volumetric vs. gross vs. chargeable weight calculations and crafting end-to-end freight quotations

title: Mastering Conflict & Negotiation
description:
An Executive 6-Hour B2B Masterclass Tailored for Emerging Leaders in Logistics & Supply Chain Operations.

Turn Operational Friction into Business Advantage. Standard leadership workshops focus on abstract corporate communication and fail in logistics because they ignore high-pressure operational friction—such as warehouse SLA breaches, vessel demurrage disputes, and carrier freight rate pinches. This program transforms conflict into operational efficiency, equipping mid-level managers with domain-tailored negotiation tactics to directly reduce SLA delays, protect vendor margins, and avoid multi-party disputes.
objective: To equip emerging leaders in logistics and supply chain operations with practical negotiation tools, conflict resolution frameworks, and real-world supply chain simulations to resolve operational friction, assert commercial firmness, and build resilient business partnerships.
targetAudience: Emerging leaders, operational leads, and mid-level managers in logistics & supply chain operations
Warehouse managers, transport coordinators, and port operations leads handling daily friction
Freight forwarding, NVOCC, and shipper teams negotiating ocean & air freight rates, demurrage, and terms
Supply chain account managers and commercial procurement specialists managing multi-party contracts

Negotiate freight rates, demurrage, and contract terms with confidence while creating win-win commercial outcomes
Gain domain-tailored negotiation tactics and conflict resolution frameworks you can apply from Day 1
